paras: Dierogekko thomaswhitei, also known commonly as White's nimble gecko and the  Taom striped gecko, is a species of lizard in the family Diplodactylidae. The species is endemic to New Caledonia.
The specific name, thomaswhitei, is in honor of "Dr. Thomas White".
D. thomaswhitei is found on the island of Grande Terre, in North Province, New Caledonia.
The preferred natural habitats of D. thomaswhitei are forest and shrubland, at altitudes of 300–1,000 m (980–3,280 ft).
Relatively large for its genus, D. thomaswhitei may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of 4.5 cm (1.8 in).
